_comment: COORD RULE (confirmed 2026-07-24): the engine scales incoming click coords by 0.8 (1024/1280). To hit something seen at capture (cx,cy) SEND (cx*1.25, cy*1.25). Buttons/lists prefer the injection hook (press:/select:), which needs no coords. Full element map: ../ui_map.json

REMOVED 2026-07-25: a scrollbar click at (996,562) plus a scrolled_to_mom assert. Law L7 -- clicks are DEAD in CTP2 menus (aui polls GetCursorPos; measured 0/36 on a grid sweep). Measured proof: the list was still at the TOP of the scenario list (Apolyton/Alexander/Sieben) while the golden showed the scrolled view, so the click never landed and the old VERIFIED comment was wrong. The scroll was purely cosmetic -- SelectItem below is index-based and needs no visible row -- and the assert tested a state this harness cannot produce headlessly.

MoM is selected by INDEX INJECTION (aui_ListBox::SelectItem), not by a click - it works regardless of scroll position. A coordinate click on a row worked BEFORE a scroll but not AFTER one (unexplained).
OK == ScenarioWindow.LoadButton (str_ldl_SCEN_LOAD); drills into the MoM pack
FRONTIER E1: confirm the pack. select inner row 0 then OK. PREDICTION: panel closes -> back at new_game with scenario set.
FRONTIER E2: LAUNCH. PREDICTION: long load then the map screen. SLIC only enters scope here (L5).
OBJECTIVE: fire the j hotkey and capture the MagicMenu alertbox. L5 satisfied - SLIC compiled fresh by this new game (confirmed: the BeginTurn 'Magic Power' box is already on screen).
Baseline shot immediately before the key, so the L4 delta isolates j's effect alone.
PREDICTION: delta ~180k (panel opened) and a MAGIC STATUS alertbox visible. delta 0 => key never landed OR the on-screen message box ate it; delta ~477k => crash.
Assert ONLY the alertbox region: the map is generated per run, so any golden covering terrain would be flaky by construction. The alertbox is deterministic.

name: magic_menu_check
_comment: RE-BASELINED 2026-07-25: the alertbox gained the Random/Research/Goal battery buttons (links 5+6), so the old one-button golden was legitimately stale. Cropped tight to the box -- the old 394-tall crop trailed ~200 rows of black that padded the score.
